tooltips.Burn: Damage-over-time. Some effects convert Burn ticks into Decay stacks.
tooltips.Decay: Entropy marker that amplifies detonation effects (+10% per stack baseline).
tooltips.Subservience: Obedience debuff that can be consumed to gain temporary control.
tooltips.Stasis: Freezes actions or increases cooldown; short, high-impact lockdown.
tooltips.Discord: Reduces buff effectiveness and disrupts synergies.
tooltips.Void: Resource denial state enabling Banish interactions.
tooltips.Consume: Remove stacks to gain an immediate benefit.
tooltips.Detonate: Convert stacks into burst effects based on per-stack math.
tooltips.Banish: Temporarily remove a unit/glyph from play; returns by timer or tax.
tooltips.Silence: Prevents casting for a short window; cleansed by some effects.
tooltips.Shield: Absorbs incoming damage; some interactions can sunder.
tooltips.Heal: Restore Ojas/HP; may also cleanse under Venus or Blessing.
tooltips.Cleanse: Remove one or more negative effects from a target.
tooltips.Transmute: Transform incoming damage into healing or resources.
tooltips.Omen: Tagged draw with a conditional bonus clause.
tooltips.Scry: Peek/reorder the top of the deck to improve draw quality.
tooltips.Foretell: Create a delayed discounted copy to play later.
tooltips.Seal: Protect the next draw/effect from disruption.
tooltips.Chant: Stackable ritual counter; breakpoints unlock windows.
tooltips.Invoke: Primary Invocation payload; often enhanced by chanting.
tooltips.Field: Area effect zone; provides passive or defensive benefits.
tooltips.Anchor: Stateful marker that preserves or augments future actions.
tooltips.Amplify: Boost an existing Field/Anchor instead of stacking a new one.
tooltips.Collapse: Consume threshold for powerful AoE or banish effects.
tooltips.Mark: Target tag enabling precision bonuses and vulnerability pivots.
tooltips.Expose: Reveal a weakness; consuming yields refresh or combo hooks.
tooltips.Vulnerable: +25% damage taken from sources that check this state.
